lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are organized in a structured grid posterior to the gill slits. A primary vertical axis contains four distinct spots, with multiple parallel axes extending posteriorly across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular spots, forming a coordinate-like grid arrangement visible on the mid-to-posterior lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent linear features exhibit a sharp vertical luminance gradient, characterized by bright superior edges and dark inferior shadows, running horizontally along the upper third of the visible flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots is bounded within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily localized near the anterior margin and the mid-section of the fin surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single, high-chroma orange-brown elliptical feature is located on the mid-lateral flank, approximately one-third of the visible body length posterior from the pectoral fin insertion.
other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately five small, elongated high-luminance silhouettes are positioned in close proximity to the ventral surface of the primary pectoral fin.
